int_name: N AMERICAN ST & W WESTMORELAND ST

result.summary: The image depicts a two-lane urban street with sidewalks and a marked zebra crosswalk. While basic pedestrian infrastructure is present, safety is limited by parked vehicles obstructing sightlines and a lack of active traffic control or calming measures for the main roadway.

hazards.name: Sightline Obstruction
hazards.description: Parked vehicles on the right side of the street near the intersection block the view between pedestrians at the curb and approaching motorists.
hazards.location_in_image: Right side of the roadway, just beyond the crosswalk

hazards.name: Worn Pavement Markings
hazards.description: The zebra crosswalk markings are faded and worn, reducing their visibility to drivers.

hazards.name: Debris and Poor Drainage Area
hazards.description: Litter and debris accumulated near the storm drain create a slip/trip hazard at the edge of the pedestrian path.
hazards.location_in_image: Bottom right corner near the curb and storm grate

interventions.title: Intersection Daylighting
interventions.description: Remove parking spaces immediately adjacent to the crosswalk to improve visibility for all road users.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions (Bulb-outs)
interventions.description: Extend the sidewalk into the parking lane to shorten the crossing distance and improve pedestrian visibility.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalk Repainting
interventions.description: Refresh the zebra markings with high-visibility, durable materials to ensure the crossing is prominent.

result.summary: The image shows a narrow one-way residential street with parking on both sides and continuous sidewalks. There are no marked crosswalks or pedestrian signals visible at the immediate intersection, and parked vehicles likely obstruct sightlines between drivers and pedestrians.

hazards.name: Visual Obstruction from Parked Cars
hazards.description: Parked vehicles along the curb line block the view of pedestrians attempting to cross the street, especially at the intersection.
hazards.location_in_image: Along both sides of the roadway

hazards.name: Lack of Marked Crosswalks
hazards.description: There are no painted markings to indicate where pedestrians should cross or to alert drivers to expect pedestrians.

interventions.title: Daylighting
interventions.description: Remove parking spaces closest to the intersection to improve sightlines for both drivers and pedestrians.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Install continental-style marked crosswalks to clearly define pedestrian paths.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Extend the sidewalk into the parking lane at the intersection to shorten crossing distance and improve visibility.

result.summary: The pedestrian environment is characterized by existing but poorly maintained infrastructure, including a faded crosswalk and sidewalks obstructed by significant amounts of trash and debris. The lack of signalization and presence of parked vehicles near the intersection further reduce safety by limiting visibility and forcing pedestrians into the roadway.

hazards.name: Sidewalk Obstruction
hazards.description: Large piles of trash and debris completely block the sidewalk on the left, forcing pedestrians to walk in the street.

hazards.name: Faded Crosswalk
hazards.description: The zebra-style crosswalk markings are significantly worn, reducing their visibility to approaching drivers.

hazards.name: Sightline Obstruction
hazards.description: Parked vehicles are situated very close to the intersection, obscuring the view between pedestrians and motorists.
hazards.location_in_image: Right side of the roadway near the crossing
